name: Diamond Tennis Necklace
description: A seamless line of brilliant diamonds that rests effortlessly at the collarbone. Made to order and sized to you.
alt: Model wearing a diamond tennis necklace

name: Rose Gold Infinity Pendant
description: A graceful infinity twist in warm rose gold, set with a sparkling pear-cut stone. Delicate enough for everyday wear.
alt: Rose gold infinity pendant with a pear-shaped diamond, worn on a model

name: Pear Diamond Solitaire Pendant
description: A single pear-cut stone on a fine chain — simple, timeless, and made to catch the light with every movement.
alt: Pear-cut diamond solitaire pendant on a fine chain

name: Tennis Bracelet Stack
description: Designed to layer and made for everyday wear. Stack two or three lengths for a quietly show-stopping wrist.
alt: Model wearing a stack of diamond tennis bracelets

name: Classic Tennis Bracelet
description: The icon, refined. A continuous row of oval-cut diamonds with a low, comfortable profile.
alt: Diamond tennis bracelet on wrist, outdoor setting

name: Bezel Diamond Bracelet
description: Diamonds set in warm gold bezels for a smooth, modern take on the tennis classic.

name: Crisscross Diamond Ring
description: A sculpted crossover band pavé-set with diamonds. Bold on its own, striking when stacked.
alt: Gold crisscross diamond ring on finger

name: Oval Diamond Ring Set
description: An oval center stone with a pavé-set band — a modern heirloom for the moment that matters.
alt: Oval cut diamond engagement ring with matching band

name: Blue Halo Statement Ring
description: A radiant-cut blue center stone framed by a sparkling diamond halo. Made to be noticed.
alt: Radiant cut blue gemstone ring with diamond halo

name: Marquise Blue Ring
description: A marquise-cut blue stone on a sculptural crossover band with warm gold prongs. One of a kind.
alt: Marquise cut blue gemstone ring in gold setting
